column1: # Ochsner GMWW (OTE3) - PROTECTED write messages for ebusd (verified 2026-11 on SW 5.98) - see docs/ochsner_tem_protocol.md section 10
# Line 1 MUST be the column header above (it adds the range column) - do not put a comment line first.
# WHITELIST: only these messages are writable. Everything else (heating curve - limits - date) is intentionally missing.
# Access level "write" (circuit ochsner#write): only visible after "auth <user> <secret>" with a user from --aclfile (see acl.example).
#   Anonymous ebusctl clients and MQTT (ebusd ACL user "mqtt") cannot write unless you give that user the level write.
# Telegram (captured from the control panel): QQ 10 06 23 06 <ID 4 bytes> <value 2 bytes LE> - enums are 2 bytes (UIN) not UCH.
# Temperatures are VALUE LISTS on purpose: ebusd 26.1 checks only min/max of the range column but NOT the step
#   (30.3 was sent in a test). Value lists are checked strictly - only the listed names can be written.
#   Write the exact name: manual setpoint 30.0 / 30.5 (not 30) - DHW setpoint 43 (not 43.0).
# Limits are the operator's choice (controller itself accepts manual setpoint 1-90 C) - adapt to YOUR system before use.
# Never write the date 02-070 (ebusd DAY shows +1 day). Wait at least 10 s between write commands.
